name: stock-ledger
title: Stock ledger
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Running balance by SKU and warehouse, with an adjustment and transfer dialog. Signed quantities use a real minus and a spoken name.

"use client" /** * Stock ledger. Clean-room reading of a public inventory list: running balance * per SKU and warehouse, signed quantities, and a card list at 390px. * No template source, copy, icons, or assets. RUI-QTY-001 and RUI-BAL-001 * are applied as draft rules, not as a hub change. */ import * as React from "react" import { useReducedMotion } from "motion/react" import { ArrowDownToLine, ArrowRightFromLine, ArrowRightToLine, ArrowUpFromLine, SlidersHorizontal, } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input" import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label" import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, } from "@/components/ui/select" import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, } from "@/components/ui/sheet" import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { useMinWidth } from "@/hooks/use-min-width" import { balanceAccessibleName, balanceBy, formatBalance, formatMovementDate, formatSignedQuantity, movementTotals, quantityAccessibleName, runningBalances, type StockMovement, type StockMovementKind, } from "@/lib/stock-ledger" import { AdminDataTable } from "@/components/ui/data-table" import { EventLog } from "@/components/ui/event-log" import { StatStrip } from "@/components/ui/stat-strip" import { StatusPill, type StatusTone } from "@/components/ui/status-pill" export type StockLedgerStatus = "ready" | "loading" | "error" export type StockBalanceScope = "global" | "filter" export type StockLedgerFilters = { kind: StockMovementKind | "all" warehouseId: string from: string to: string query: string balanceScope: StockBalanceScope } export const emptyStockLedgerFilters: StockLedgerFilters = { kind: "all", warehouseId: "all", from: "", to: "", query: "", balanceScope: "global", } export type StockLedgerClassNames = { root?: string header?: string toolbar?: string table?: string card?: string qty?: string balance?: string } export type StockLedgerLabels = { caption: string captionForSku: (sku: string) => string date: string type: string reference: string warehouse: string quantity: string balanceGlobal: string balanceFiltered: string emptyTitle: string emptyAction: string transferAction: string filteredEmptyTitle: string clearFilters: string loading: string errorTitle: string retry: string negative: string filters: string closeFilters: string kind: string allKinds: string allWarehouses: string from: string to: string search: string scope: string scopeGlobal: string scopeFiltered: string onHand: string inbound: string outbound: string net: string logTitle: string noReference: string unit: string kinds: Record } const kindTone: Record = { in: "positive", out: "info", adjust: "accent", transfer_out: "neutral", transfer_in: "neutral", } const kindIcon = { in: ArrowDownToLine, out: ArrowUpFromLine, adjust: SlidersHorizontal, transfer_out: ArrowRightFromLine, transfer_in: ArrowRightToLine, } as const const numericStyle = { fontVariantNumeric: "tabular-nums", textAlign: "end" } as const export function stockLedgerLabels(locale: string): StockLedgerLabels { if (locale.toLowerCase().startsWith("en")) { return { caption: "Inventory movements", captionForSku: (sku) => `Movements for ${sku}`, date: "Date", type: "Type", reference: "Reference", warehouse: "Warehouse", quantity: "Quantity", balanceGlobal: "Global balance", balanceFiltered: "Filtered balance", emptyTitle: "No movements", emptyAction: "Record adjustment", transferAction: "Record transfer", filteredEmptyTitle: "No movements match", clearFilters: "Clear filters", loading: "Loading movements", errorTitle: "The ledger could not be read", retry: "Retry", negative: "Negative balance", filters: "Filters", closeFilters: "Close filters", kind: "Type", allKinds: "All types", allWarehouses: "All warehouses", from: "From", to: "To", search: "Search SKU", scope: "Balance", scopeGlobal: "Global", scopeFiltered: "Filtered", onHand: "On hand", inbound: "Inbound", outbound: "Outbound", net: "Net", logTitle: "Movement log", noReference: "No reference", unit: "units", kinds: { in: "In", out: "Out", adjust: "Adjustment", transfer_out: "Transfer out", transfer_in: "Transfer in", }, } } return { caption: "Movimientos de inventario", captionForSku: (sku) => `Movimientos de ${sku}`, date: "Fecha", type: "Tipo", reference: "Referencia", warehouse: "Almacén", quantity: "Cantidad", balanceGlobal: "Saldo global", balanceFiltered: "Saldo del filtro", emptyTitle: "No hay movimientos", emptyAction: "Registrar ajuste", transferAction: "Registrar transferencia", filteredEmptyTitle: "Ningún movimiento coincide", clearFilters: "Limpiar filtros", loading: "Cargando movimientos", errorTitle: "No se pudo leer el libro", retry: "Reintentar", negative: "Saldo negativo", filters: "Filtros", closeFilters: "Cerrar filtros", kind: "Tipo", allKinds: "Todos los tipos", allWarehouses: "Todos los almacenes", from: "Desde", to: "Hasta", search: "Buscar SKU", scope: "Saldo", scopeGlobal: "Global", scopeFiltered: "Del filtro", onHand: "Disponible", inbound: "Entradas", outbound: "Salidas", net: "Neto", logTitle: "Registro de movimientos", noReference: "Sin referencia", unit: "unidades", kinds: { in: "Entrada", out: "Salida", adjust: "Ajuste", transfer_out: "Transferencia de salida", transfer_in: "Transferencia de entrada", }, } } export type StockLedgerProps = { movements: readonly StockMovement[] warehouses: readonly { id: string; label: string }[] sku?: string status?: StockLedgerStatus error?: string onRetry?: () => void filters?: StockLedgerFilters onFiltersChange?: (filters: StockLedgerFilters) => void locale?: string unit?: string labels?: Partial> & { kinds?: Partial captionForSku?: StockLedgerLabels["captionForSku"] } className?: string classNames?: StockLedgerClassNames onAdjust?: () => void onTransfer?: () => void highlightIds?: readonly string[] } type LedgerRow = { id: string movement: StockMovement balance: number negative: boolean } function mergeLabels(locale: string, labels: StockLedgerProps["labels"]): StockLedgerLabels { const base = stockLedgerLabels(locale) if (!labels) return base return { ...base, ...labels, kinds: { ...base.kinds, ...labels.kinds } } } function inDateRange(movement: StockMovement, filters: StockLedgerFilters) { const day = movement.at.slice(0, 10) if (filters.from && day < filters.from) return false if (filters.to && day > filters.to) return false return true } function matches(movement: StockMovement, filters: StockLedgerFilters, warehouseName: string) { if (filters.kind !== "all" && movement.kind !== filters.kind) return false if (filters.warehouseId !== "all" && movement.warehouseId !== filters.warehouseId) return false if (!inDateRange(movement, filters)) return false const query = filters.query.trim().toLowerCase() if (!query) return true return [movement.sku, movement.ref, movement.reason, movement.id, warehouseName] .filter(Boolean) .join(" ") .toLowerCase() .includes(query) } function Figure({ name, visual, className }: { name: string; visual: string; className?: string }) { return ( {name} {visual} ) } function KindPill({ kind, labels }: { kind: StockMovementKind; labels: StockLedgerLabels }) { const Icon = kindIcon[kind] return ( } /> ) } export function StockLedger({ movements, warehouses, sku, status = "ready", error, onRetry, filters: controlledFilters, onFiltersChange, locale = "es-MX", unit, labels: labelOverrides, className, classNames, onAdjust, onTransfer, highlightIds, }: StockLedgerProps) { const labels = mergeLabels(locale, labelOverrides) const unitLabel = unit ?? labels.unit const wide = useMinWidth(640) const reduced = useReducedMotion() === true const headingId = React.useId() const [uncontrolled, setUncontrolled] = React.useState(emptyStockLedgerFilters) const [filtersOpen, setFiltersOpen] = React.useState(false) const filters = controlledFilters ?? uncontrolled const warehouseName = new Map(warehouses.map((item) => [item.id, item.label])) const nameFor = (id: string) => warehouseName.get(id) ?? id function updateFilters(next: StockLedgerFilters) { onFiltersChange?.(next) if (controlledFilters === undefined) setUncontrolled(next) } const scoped = sku ? movements.filter((movement) => movement.sku === sku) : movements const globalRows = runningBalances(scoped) const rows: LedgerRow[] = filters.balanceScope === "filter" ? runningBalances(scoped.filter((movement) => matches(movement, filters, nameFor(movement.warehouseId)))).map((row) => ({ id: row.movement.id, ...row })) : globalRows .filter((row) => matches(row.movement, filters, nameFor(row.movement.warehouseId))) .map((row) => ({ id: row.movement.id, ...row })) const period = movementTotals(scoped.filter((movement) => inDateRange(movement, filters))) let onHand = 0 for (const value of balanceBy(scoped).values()) onHand += value const caption = sku ? labels.captionForSku(sku) : labels.caption const balanceHeader = filters.balanceScope === "filter" ? labels.balanceFiltered : labels.balanceGlobal const highlighted = new Set(highlightIds ?? meta.descriptionEs: Saldo corriente por SKU y almacén, con un diálogo para ajustes y transferencias. La cantidad lleva signo y se lee en palabras.
meta.usage:
<StockLedger
  movements={movements}
  warehouses={warehouses}
  locale="es-MX"
  onAdjust={openAdjust}
/>

<StockMovementDialog
  open={open}
  onOpenChange={setOpen}
  mode="adjust"
  skus={skus}
  warehouses={warehouses}
  balances={balances}
  reasons={reasons}
  onSubmit={save}
/>

api.name: movements
api.description: id, at, sku, warehouseId, kind, signed qty, optional reason, ref, and transferId.

api.name: runningBalances
api.description: Stable order by at, then id. Balance is per SKU and warehouse. Scope only hides rows.

api.name: balanceBy / validateMovement / toTransferPair / belowReorder
api.description: Final balances, field errors, a transfer pair with one id, and the reorder check.

api.name: sku / filters
api.description: Product view adds the stat strip. Filters are controlled or internal. Balance stays global unless balanceScope is filter.

api.name: status / onRetry
api.description: Loading keeps a stable skeleton. Error keeps the message and a retry button.

api.name: StockMovementDialog mode
api.description: One dialog. onSubmit receives one adjustment or a transfer pair. Pending disables the button.

api.name: locale / unit / labels
api.description: Default es-MX. Locales starting with en use the English set. Unit defaults to unidades or units.

docs: Clean-room reading of the public Cargorix inventory ledger (shadcn/studio Pro, not purchased). Only the idea, layout, and interaction were used. No source, sample data, icons, or assets were copied. The demo uses invented SKUs (SKU-0001) and warehouses (Almacén Norte / Almacén Sur). Signed quantities follow draft rule RUI-QTY-001 (U+2212, tabular-nums, spoken sign). The running balance follows draft rule RUI-BAL-001 (stable order, global by SKU and warehouse unless the column says the filter). Those rules are proposed, not applied to the hub. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has, or data-table, status-pill, number-field, event-log, stat-strip, or use-min-width when they are already installed. The item ships no theme.
